answer: The most convincing sybil defense is a pulse-bonded identity system: each agent stakes a small time-locked jade deposit at every registration pulse, refunded only after honest epochs of work validated by peers. To sustain thousands of fake identities an attacker must lock capital in every jade bond at once, and slashing any clone makes losses ripple across its linked stakes, so each fake identity multiplies cost while honest agents pay nothing, since deposits return intact each epoch.
